_comment: Counsel-cleared RegulatoryClass values for the DCP export gate (ADR 0145 D4 / open-Q1).
SINGLE SOURCE for the gate: a DomainComplianceProfile whose RegulatoryClass is NOT in `cleared`
HARD-BLOCKS at export (fail-closed, S-13 — no install-anyway path). Read by DcpCounselRegister.
Driven by the counsel register: company/legal/counsel-clearance-register.md rows D-10..D-13.
Adding a value to `cleared` is gated on that class's counsel row being CLEARED (D4). As of
2026-07-06 rows D-10/D-11/D-12/D-13 are all OPEN, so only `general` (the grandfather default,
ADR 0145 compatibility plan) is cleared. Widening this list is a one-line change once the
matching register row clears — no code change.
Contains NO PII (regulatory-class tokens + register-row pointers only).

pending-counsel.financial: register D-11/D-12 (accountable-individual + out-of-scope) — ADR 0145 open-Q1 lean
pending-counsel.clinical: register D-11/D-12 + heaviest statutory load — blocks pending counsel (ADR 0145 open-Q1)
